packageRules.description: The same grouping the payload ships to generated repositories. These pins are the ones consumers receive, so they are held to the same review shape.
ADR-0009 pins every `uses:` to a commit SHA with the version as a trailing comment. Renovate must keep both halves in step, which means digest pinning on.

customManagers.description: Pinned actions inside the payload's `.jinja` workflow files. The github-actions manager only reads real workflow filenames, so without this the pins the template ships to every generated repository would never be updated.
Pinned CLI tools in workflow and devcontainer commands. `pipx install pkg==1.2.3` is a string, not a manifest, so no built-in manager sees it and the pin would rot unnoticed.
actionlint, installed with `go install`. The module path is named explicitly because the command points at a package, which a Go datasource cannot resolve from the string alone.
shfmt, installed with `go install`, for the same reason as actionlint.
